subjects.description: A yellow convertible taxi cab with its roof down, travelling at speed along a suburban boulevard with two passengers aboard.
subjects.appearance_details: Deep gloss yellow lacquer dulled by a film of road salt, grey slush thrown up behind the wheel arches and crusted along the sills, a wet sheen across the bonnet where snowmelt runs off, chrome bumpers cold and bluish with meltwater beading on them, an illuminated roof sign glowing warm against the grey air, winter tyres cutting dark tracks through surface snow.
subjects.position: Centre frame in profile, travelling from left to right, filling the lower two thirds of the image

subjects.description: Two passengers riding in the open car, one in the rear seat with arms raised, one seated beside the driver.
subjects.appearance_details: The woman in the rear seat wears a cream shearling coat over a chunky roll-neck sweater, a deep red knitted scarf streaming backward and a matching beanie pulled low, leather gloves on the door frame. Her companion is in a quilted parka with the hood down. Breath condenses in the freezing air and streams away behind them, cheeks reddened by cold.
subjects.position: In the open cabin at the centre of the vehicle, upper middle of the frame

background_setting: A wide boulevard under deep snow, banks of ploughed snow heaped along the kerb and grey slush tracked across the carriageway in dark wheel lines. Bare deciduous trees stand with snow lying along their branches. A low wall runs behind the pavement, its coping capped white. Buildings recede into cold grey haze, roofs snow-covered, lights burning in a few windows against the dim afternoon.

lighting.conditions: Flat overcast winter daylight under heavy snow cloud
lighting.direction: Diffuse and near-directionless, marginally brighter from above
lighting.shadows: Soft, weak and short, with only a faint contact shadow beneath the car in the compacted snow
lighting.illumination_effect: Cold blue-grey ambient light at low contrast, the snow acting as a huge reflector filling the underside of the car; the roof sign and tail lights are the only warm sources

aesthetics.composition: Medium-wide profile framing that holds the car centrally as it travels, the boundary wall and palms forming a horizontal band across the upper third and the roadway occupying the lower third, with the vehicle bridging the two
aesthetics.color_scheme: Desaturated blue-greys and whites of snow and overcast sky, dark wet asphalt showing through in wheel tracks, with the yellow bodywork and warm tail lights the only saturated colour in frame
aesthetics.visual_texture: Snow crystal detail on the banks, slush spray caught mid-air, salt film and water beading on paintwork, wet tyre tread throwing fine mist

cinematography.camera_motion: Tracking laterally alongside the vehicle at matching speed, holding it steady in frame while the background streaks past
cinematography.camera_angle: Slightly elevated, a little above the roofline, looking gently down at the car in profile
cinematography.depth_of_field: Moderate, the vehicle sharp with the background softened by distance and motion
cinematography.focus: Locked on the moving car throughout
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Medium telephoto, compressing the background behind the vehicle

style_medium: Live-action video captured on a full-frame digital cinema camera from a tracking vehicle in winter conditions
artistic_style: Photorealistic automotive cinematography, cold and naturalistic
context: A tracking shot of a convertible taxi driving through a snow-covered boulevard on an overcast winter afternoon

actions.description: The taxi travels left to right through packed snow, the camera holding pace alongside as slush sprays from the tyres and snow-laden trees pass behind.
The car continues across the frame, the passengers' breath streaming backward in the cold air, meltwater running back across the bonnet.

segments.description: A tracking shot of a convertible taxi driving through a snow-covered boulevard on an overcast winter afternoon
segments.key_changes: Specular highlights travel along the bodywork as the car moves; the background wall, hedging and palms sweep past in motion blur while the vehicle stays locked in frame.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 a yellow taxi moves left to right along a snow-covered boulevard under flat grey light, the camera tracking alongside as slush sprays from beneath the tyres. By 0:01 the wheels cut dark lines through surface snow and the woman's red scarf streams backward in the freezing air. Through to 0:02 the car holds its place in frame, salt film and meltwater glistening on the yellow paintwork, while ploughed snow banks and bare trees sweep past behind.
audio_description: A muffled engine note under load, tyres compressing packed snow with a crunching hiss, wind across the open cabin, and the dulled acoustics of a snow-covered street. No dialogue or music.
